note: The seven stations of the island (GAME_PROMPT.md section 4). Narration ids refer to content/narration.json; the question is spoken at the end of each narration and shown quietly afterwards.

stations.title: The Magician
stations.geometry: A vertical beam of light joining sky and earth, with a thin gold ring floating at its midpoint.
stations.interaction: Step into the ring: the beam brightens and particles rise; the wanderer reaches upward.
stations.question: What am I truly reaching for?
stations.transcriptRoot: the untaught seeker, the beginner's mind, reaching, reaching and again reaching
stations.theory: Theory (b) Mind 1, Matrix of the Mind: Ra 78.33

stations.title: The High Priestess
stations.essence: Stillness and intuition; answers rise in silence.
stations.geometry: Two dark pillars with a veil of slow mist between them; a crescent of pale light above.
stations.interaction: Sit: time slows, the mist parts slightly, stars emerge.
stations.question: What begins to surface?
stations.transcriptRoot: that which receives the desire and enables it, by a process of reflection and blessing
stations.theory: Theory (b) Mind 2, Potentiator of the Mind: Ra 78.34; Q'uo 23 May 1993

stations.title: The Empress
stations.essence: Catalyst; life as the teacher that changes you.
stations.geometry: A spiral path of softly glowing garden beds; vines of light climb through the air.
stations.interaction: Walk the spiral inward: soft ascending tones; at the centre a bloom of light opens.
stations.question: What is it trying to give you?
stations.transcriptRoot: that which acts upon the conscious mind to change it
stations.theory: Theory (b) Mind 3, Catalyst of the Mind: Ra 78.36

stations.title: The Emperor
stations.essence: Experience as a treasury; honouring what you have lived.
stations.geometry: A dark stone cube as a throne, set on a square of pale light.
stations.interaction: Sit on the throne: faint constellations appear overhead, memory stars.
stations.question: What have you made of me?
stations.transcriptRoot: the conscious mind, ennobled by the use of the vast resources of the unconscious mind
stations.theory: Theory (b) Mind 4, Experience of the Mind: Ra 78.37

stations.title: The Hierophant
stations.essence: The inner teacher; the watcher behind thoughts.
stations.geometry: An archway of three stones; the air beneath it shimmers faintly.
stations.interaction: Walk through the arch: a slow ripple goes outward and a low warm tone sounds.
stations.question: What did you learn?
stations.transcriptRoot: the heart of the mind is that dynamic entity which absorbs, seeks, and attempts to learn
stations.theory: Theory (b) Mind 5, Significator of the Mind: Ra 79.36, 79.42

stations.title: The Lovers
stations.essence: Choice and freedom; the crossroads of transformation.
stations.geometry: Two large intersecting rings lying flat (a vesica), with two paths crossing beneath a bright star.
stations.interaction: Choose a path; both curve and rejoin. At the crossing the rings pulse once, gently.
stations.question: If I were free, truly free, which way would my heart lean?
stations.transcriptRoot: two equal choices, neither greater than the other
stations.theory: Theory (b) Mind 6, Transformation of the Mind: Ra 79.40

stations.title: The Chariot
stations.essence: Integration; the road was one road all along.
stations.geometry: A small vessel of light at the head of a long straight road running to the horizon.
stations.interaction: Board the vessel (after the other six): a slow, dreamlike ride past echoes of the six stations, ending at the shore for the swim home.
stations.question: The way forward is the way inward.
stations.transcriptRoot: a reflection and substantial summary of Archetypes One through Six
stations.theory: Theory (b) Mind 7, Great Way of the Mind: Ra 79.41
